summary: Road-network routing configuration: mode, avoid/exclude, truck attributes, profiles, traffic.
range: Object of routing options. mode defaults to car.
businessRules: routing defines: This attribute is used to define the routing configurations for the optimization job.
Must stay consistent with: options.routing.mode, options.routing.avoid, options.routing.exclude. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: mode=truck with truck_size/weight for HGV routing.
